verdict.rationale: Steel's CLI documents click/fill/type primitives (steel-docs-8), and its AI SDK integration offers a page 'snapshot' tool (steel-docs-39). The DOM- or vision-level element understanding comes from third-party layers running on Steel sessions, such as Browser-Use and OpenAI/Claude/Gemini computer use (steel-docs-20, steel-docs-19, steel-docs-18), not from a first-party act-on-described-element API. missing for 10: a first-party natural-language act/click/type-on-described-element primitive, any documentation that actions survive selector or layout changes, a description of how elements are targeted (selectors vs. refs vs. descriptions), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
